19 Delta neighbourhood guides: Ladner, Tsawwassen and North Delta

parts.t: One guide for each Delta MLS® sub-area I have written up so far, across Ladner, Tsawwassen and North Delta. Each covers schools, parks, planning and what to check before you buy, with a source next to every fact.
Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty. Updated October 15, 2026. I have worked in Lower Mainland real estate for 11+ years.
Ladner is a heritage fishing town in the northwest corner of the City of Delta. The guides follow MLS® sub-area names, which are not City boundaries.

Which Delta areas have a guide?

Nineteen. In Ladner: Ladner Elementary, Hawthorne, Holly, Neilsen Grove, Port Guichon, Delta Manor, East Delta, Ladner Rural and Westham Island. In Tsawwassen: Beach Grove, Boundary Beach, English Bluff, Tsawwassen Central, Tsawwassen North and Tsawwassen East. In North Delta: Annieville, Nordel, Scottsdale and Sunshine Hills Woods. Each follows its MLS® sub-area name.
How are the North Delta guides split up?
They follow the four North Delta MLS® sub-areas:
. These are real estate areas, not City boundaries, and their edges are approximate, so ask me if a specific address is in one.
Is it Neilsen Grove or Neilson Grove?
Both spellings are in use. Neilsen Grove is the MLS® sub-area name used in listing searches, and the school is Neilson Grove Elementary. See the
Do these areas have official boundaries?
Most are MLS® sub-area names used by the real estate board rather than municipal boundary lines, so each guide places schools, parks, and zoning facts by specific street address.

Most of the land in East Delta, Ladner Rural and Westham Island is farmland, and those guides cover the Agricultural Land Reserve rules. ALR status is set parcel by parcel, so check the exact address on the
How do I check the school for an address?

, since catchments can be split. Each guide links each school’s own site.
